title: Telemetry-driven POP decision graph using p50/p95 latency and network integrity scoring
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a decision-graph based POP (point-of-presence) selector that combines p50 and p95 latency telemetry with a network integrity score to choose region/tier routing and fallback model variants. The system should prioritize low-latency POPs while avoiding regions with degraded network health. It should gracefully fall back to cheaper model variants when capacity or network penalties exceed thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Decision graph config accepts inputs: p50, p95, recent packet_loss, retransmit_rate, and egress_errors.
Selector outputs stable POP with hysteresis to avoid route flapping (min stickiness 60s).
Fallback order: same-POP cheaper variant -> nearest healthy POP same-tier -> cross-tier dedicated -> hosted fallback model. All steps logged and traceable.
Automated e2e tests simulate synthetic latency spikes and network drops to validate fallback transitions.
Dashboard shows per-POP p50/p95, health score, selected variant, and transition counts; alerting rules for repeated failovers.
tasks: Design decision-graph schema and YAML config format for policy authors.
Implement telemetry aggregator (EWMA + percentile window) that exposes p50/p95 per POP.
Compute network integrity score from packet loss, retransmits, and connection error rate (0-100).
Build selector service that queries telemetry and evaluates decision graph for each request class.
Add deterministic hysteresis and cool-down timers to the selector to prevent oscillation.
Implement fallback variant registry and API for variant compatibility mapping.
Create canary rollout plan and feature flag control in routing service.
Ship dashboards, SLO checks, and PagerDuty playbook for failovers.
decisions: Use two percentile inputs (p50 for typical latency, p95 for tail risk) weighted 0.6/0.4 in base score.
Network integrity score computed as 100 - clamp(50*packet_loss + 30*retransmit_rate + 20*egress_error_rate).
If composite score falls below 40 or p95 exceeds 1500ms, mark POP unhealthy for 30s and trigger fallback.
Fallback prefers local model-quantized variants when available to preserve latency; use cross-POP only if variant incompatibility exists.
technical_notes: Telemetry window: sliding 5m for p50, 2m for p95 to capture recent tail events. Use t-digest summary for percentiles.
Store per-POP raw counters in Prometheus; use a lightweight aggregator service to compute EWMA and percentiles.
Selector must support a 'dry-run' mode that records decisions without routing changes for evaluation.
Ensure TTL of KV cache keys aligns with selector hysteresis to avoid stale routing decisions.
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (dev): unit + integration tests on synthetic data. Deploy selector behind feature flag to dev cluster.
Stage 2 (canary): route 1% traffic for non-critical tenants, dry-run for others. Observe transitions for 48h.
Stage 3 (gradual): increase to 10% then 50% over a week while monitoring fallback counts and error budgets.
Stage 4: full rollout for hosted API; Dedicated customers opt-in via console. Publish release notes and dashboard links.
